name: Shelomith
overview: The name Shelomith appears in Scripture linked to several individuals across different contexts, highlighting a diverse biblical heritage. Notably, Shelomith is identified as the mother of a blasphemer in Leviticus 24, emphasizing the seriousness of sin and its consequences within the community. Additionally, Shelomith is named as a daughter of Zerubbabel, and also appears as a son of Shimei and a descendant of Eliezer entrusted with sacred responsibilities, illustrating the varied roles associated with this name. These references collectively underscore the tangible human connections and responsibilities within God's covenant people, from family lineage to service in the temple.
